description_expanded: Top Reasons To Book the Lovely Beach Home:1. 700yds from Beach Access - at Scenic 3952. Private screened in Front Porch 3. Backyard Patio perfect for entertaining - FirePit Table, Grill, and ample seating4. Elegantly decorated with wood accents and hardwood floors throughout5. 4 Bicycles Included6. 6 Seater Golf Cart Available for an additional $75/nt (Please note: a $500 refundable deposit is required)7. Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below8. Neighborhood nature boardwalk and two community pools9. Less than 1 mile to Seaside and just a few blocks from Seagrove Village Market 10. Professionally Managed 24/7**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** *Home is equipped with outdoor surveillance cameras for your safety and protection of our property. Any attempt to disable, redirect, or obscure the cameras is prohibited and will result in eviction without a refund**Construction on the beach access is occurring and will be completed by April 30, 2025. During this time, the One Seagrove beach access will be closed, including over Spring Break. For your convenience, the nearest public beach accesses are Bramble Grove, 1 mile west, and Eastern Lake, 1 mile east.*From the moment you arrive at Bramble Cottage, you will start a new vacation tradition! With beach access less than half a mile away and just 1 mile from Seaside, you are right in the heart of all things 30A. Bramble Cottage features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and sleeps up to 6 guests comfortably. Gorgeous natural wood accents with floor to ceiling panels welcome you as you enter the main living area of the home. The bright kitchen has everything you’ll need and features all stainless steel appliances. There’s a king bed in the master suite, a full size bedroom and a bedroom with two twin beds. The outdoor area is the perfect spot to chase the Florida sunset and create lifelong memories! Complete with a fire pit table and grill, as well as plenty of seating, the backyard patio is truly serene with all the lush oak, magnolias, and pines trees surrounding! Hop on the 4 provided bikes and explore Seaside or spend the day soaking up the sun at the sparkling community pools. Come see why guests come to back to Bramble Cottage year after year! The Hammocks at Seagrove Beach is a small community of coastal homes accented with upscale touches, located in the heart of Seagrove Beach just minutes from Seaside. The Hammocks features two community pools as well as a private nature boardwalk that provides a launch point with access to Western Lake. Only a mile from Seaside, this community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle. Come experience The Hammocks at Seagrove Beach and see why you’ll be returning year after year! Area Attractions:Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous.30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world 's best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
